# Password

Generate random passwords and show their entropy.

Category: Generators · ID: `password` · Search terms: passphrase, random, secret, pwgen

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui password [flags]
```

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--length` | 4–256 | `20` | Length. |
| `--count` | 1–100 | `1` | Count. |
| `--lower` | on/off | `true` | a-z. |
| `--upper` | on/off | `true` | A-Z. |
| `--digits` | on/off | `true` | 0-9. |
| `--symbols` | on/off | `true` | Symbols. |
| `--exclude-ambiguous` | on/off | `false` | No ambiguous. Leave out 0Oo1lI\| |
